[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Interval training: Alternating between bursts of high-intensity exercise and periods of recovery (e.g., cycling at maximum effort for 30 seconds followed by a minute of recovery).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Cool Down & Stretching: 5-10 minutes of easy movements followed by stretching exercises for all major muscle groups (holding each stretch for 15-30 seconds).
